指标.原句: As shown in Fig. 6f, the Li-S cell containing the DOL/HMPA-6 electrolyte initially exhibited a higher specific capacity than the cell containing the DOL/DME electrolyte (1101.0 vs. 882.4 mAh g-1, respectively).

After 300 cycles, the specific capacity measured for the cell containing the DOL/HMPA-6 electrolyte retained signifi cantly more of its initial value than the control (619.6 vs. 295.6 mAh g-1, respectively).

At 2 C, the specific capacity measured for the Li-S cell containing the DOL/HMPA-6 electrolyte was 3.34 times higher than the value measured for the cell containing the DOL/DME electro lyte (606.4 vs. 181.5 mAh g-1).

At 2.35 V, where the polysulfide shuttle effect occurred most severely, the leakage current value measured for the cell containing the DOL/HMPA-6 electrolyte was less than half of the value measured for the control (i.e., 0.57 vs. 1.4 mA g-1, respectively), indicating that the DOL/HMPA-6 electrolyte is effective at suppressing the shuttle effect.

指标.取值点: Li‖Li 5 mA cm-2 极化（>600 h）
指标.原句: These beneficial ef fects manifested in high performance devices as Li//Li symmetric cells containing a HMPA-based electrolyte generated a significantly lower polarization voltage in stripping/plating cycling tests (for more than 600 h at 5 mA cm-2) when compared to analogous cells that contained a conventional electrolyte (c.f., 0.06 vs. 0.25 V, respectively).

备注: A 全面占优（首圈、300 圈、倍率、穿梭、负极）——'强 Li+ 亲和 + 低多硫化物溶解'属解耦型，是打破权衡的候选（需核对照是否偏弱）。硫载量、E/S、锂厚在摘录中缺失。另有 HMPA 4–10 vol% 系列只比了电导率和迁移数。
